adaptive_template_prompts.description: Ready-to-use AI prompts for generating adaptive templates

templates.name: Hero — Dark Tech
templates.prompt: Build a dark hero section with: Aurora Background (showRadialGradient=true) + Spotlight (fill='#8B5CF6') + TypewriterEffect for headline + TextGenerateEffect for subtitle + Moving Border CTA button. Stack: Next.js + Tailwind + Framer Motion.

templates.name: Hero — Particle Vortex
templates.prompt: Build a hero section with Vortex background (particleCount=700, baseHue=220) + Sparkles overlay + Magnetic Button CTA + Hero Highlight headline. Fully dark.

templates.name: Hero — Space/Cosmic
templates.prompt: Build a cosmic hero with Shooting Stars Background + Glowing Stars + Text Generate Effect headline + Meteors (number=20) + Canvas Reveal Effect on CTA hover.

templates.name: Hero — Scroll Reveal
templates.prompt: Build a scroll-driven hero with Google Gemini Effect SVG + Container Scroll Animation + Tracing Beam wrapping content + Sticky Scroll Reveal for features.

templates.name: Features — Bento Grid
templates.prompt: Build a Bento Grid features section with 3D Card Effect cards, Canvas Reveal Effect on hover, Glowing Effect borders, Moving Border on CTA.

templates.name: Testimonials — Infinite Loop
templates.prompt: Build a testimonials section with two Infinite Moving Cards rows (one left, one right direction) + Card Stack for featured testimonial + 3D Marquee background.

templates.name: Loading States — DotMatrix
templates.prompt: Add DotMatrix loaders for all loading states: 'Neon Drift' for page load (colorPreset='grad-neon'), 'Pulse Ladder' for API calls (colorPreset='solid-theme'), 'Glyph Pulse' for uploads. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @dotmatrix/dotm-square-3.

templates.name: Navbar — Premium Floating
templates.prompt: Build a premium navbar: Floating Navbar (hides on scroll) + Resizable effect + Animated Tooltip on nav icons + Moving Border on CTA + Magnetic Button effect.

templates.name: CTA — Vortex Dramatic
templates.prompt: Build a dramatic CTA section with Vortex background (baseHue=280, particleCount=1000) + Background Beams With Collision + Sparkles overlay + Stateful Button for form submit.

templates.name: Product Showcase — 3D
templates.prompt: Build a product showcase with Macbook Scroll + Hero Parallax for product images + 3D Globe for global reach + Glare Card for feature highlights.

templates.name: Creative Text Effects Stack
templates.prompt: Apply multi-layer text effects: Canvas Text for main headline + Colourful Text for accent words + Encrypted Text for tech/code reveal + Text Flipping Board for rotating stats.

templates.name: Hacker / Matrix Theme
templates.prompt: Build a Matrix/hacker theme section: Matrix Rain background (Componentry) + Encrypted Text reveal + Terminal component showing code + Dotted Glow Background overlay + 'Glyph Pulse' DotMatrix loader.
